channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound: Modest UK growth and Bailey’s cautious stance – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities projects UK GDP to grow 0.1% month-on-month in May, led by services and strong retail sales, while manufacturing and industrial output remain under pressure from Middle East-related headwinds and higher input costs.

item.title: BoC set to keep interest rates steady for sixth consecutive meeting
item.description: The Bank of Canada (BoC) is widely expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 2.25% on Wednesday. This would be the sixth consecutive event with the central bank keeping its hand steady.

item.title: Euro gives away gains as Eurozone Industrial Production disappoints
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has given away previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with the EUR/USD pair retreating to levels just above 1.1420 from session highs near 1.1450.

item.title: United States: Cool CPI provides temporary relief for rates – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Samuel Tse and Senior Rates Strategist Eugene Leow analyse USD rates after softer June CPI data. They note the US Treasuries curve bull steepened as headline and core CPI surprised to the downside, with energy and some core services prices falling.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.41 per troy ounce, down 0.46% from the $58.68 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: Indian Rupee holds early support as traders trim hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after rising significantly in the last three trading days.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD drops to near $58 even as traders scale back hawkish Fed bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 0.6% to near $58.00 during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: CEE FX: US inflation relief supports koruna and forint – ING
item.description: Frantisek Taborsky at ING says lower US inflation and reduced Fed hike expectations bring relief to CEE FX, despite higher Oil and US–Iran tensions. He maintains a bullish view on the Czech koruna and Hungarian forint, expecting more gains in coming days.

item.title: Eurozone Industrial Production unexpectedly declines 0.2% in May
item.description: The Eurozone industrial sector activity declines by 0.2% in May, while it was expected to rise at the same pace, according to data published by Eurostat. In April, the Industrial Production data rose by 0.3%, revised higher from 0.1%.

item.title: Japanese Yen hesitates near 40-year lows as Iran war, Oil prices hold bulls
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) struggles in the lower range of the 162.00s against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, not far from the 40-year lows, at 162.85. Rising geopolitical tensions and higher Oil prices offset the positive impact of the soft US consumer inflation data released on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Reaches nearly monthly lows below 1.4050
item.description: USD/CAD remains subdued after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 1.4050 during the European hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is testing the lower boundary of the symmetrical triangle.

item.title: ECB’s Panetta: Inflation to hover around 3% and remain above that level until early 2027
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and Governor of the Bank of Italy, Fabio Panetta, warned in the European trading session on Wednesday that inflationary pressures in the Eurozone economy could hover around 3% and will likely remain above that level beyond this year.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Loonie benefits from technical break – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts describe USD/CAD pulling back after failing above 1.4130, with interim resistance near 1.4250 capping gains.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Retakes 0.8100; eyes YTD high set on Tuesday amid bullish setup
item.description: The USD/CHF pair attracts some dip-buyers on Wednesday and moves further away from the weekly trough, around the 0.8060 region set the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Mixed outlook within 160.60–163.00 band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report USD/JPY fluctuated between 161.62 and 162.47, closing slightly lower at 162.23 after failing to test 162.70. Intraday, the pair is seen trading between 161.75 and 162.50.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Soft US CPI data backs upside towards 1.3500
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.1% at around 1.3403 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The GBP/USD pair gains as the US Dollar comes under selling pressure, with market participants dialing down expectations for Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes.

item.title: US Dollar: Softer inflation trims yield upside – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that softer US inflation in June has reduced upside risks to US yields, leading markets to unwind much of the July Federal Reserve hike pricing and scale back tightening expectations for 2026.

item.title: Silver: Higher beta rebound with two-way risks – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Silver has risen nearly 2%, outperforming Gold’s 1.2% gain on the back of a softer US Dollar (USD) and reduced Fed hike expectations after weak core Consumer Price Index (CPI).

item.title: ECB's Nagel: It is advisable to act decisively if needed
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council Member and President of the Deutsche Bundesbank, Joachim Nagel, said during European trading hours on Wednesday that the central bank should be prepared for monetary policy adjustments if needed.

item.title: Brent: Price spike still below stress threshold – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight a sharp two-day rally in Brent Oil driven by geopolitical tensions and Gulf-related policy headlines.

item.title: Euro trims gains against the Japanese Yen but maintains a near-term bullish trend
item.description: The Euro (EUR) pulls back from intra-week highs just above 185.60 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Wednesday but maintains its immediate bullish bias, trading 0.5% higher on the week so far.

item.title: Gold sticks to intraday losses as oil-driven inflation fears lift Fed rate hike odds
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Wednesday and remains vulnerable after the previous day's failed attempt to find acceptance above the $4,100 mark.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: BoC seen steady as Oil supports CAD – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the Bank of Canada to keep rates at 2.25%, with limited incentive to push back against modest December tightening pricing. He sees June CPI potentially falling below 3.0% as petrol prices drop, while core remains near 2.0%.

item.title: PBoC’s Deputy Governor: To continue to implement appropriately loose monetary policy
item.description: People’s Bank of China (PBoC) Deputy Governor said during the European trading session on Wednesday that the central bank remains committed to loose monetary policy conditions to support overall demand.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Upside momentum building toward 0.7015 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD surged to 0.6992 after an earlier dip, with strong short-term momentum pointing to further gains. They see scope for a test of 0.6995, while the major resistance at 0.7015 is key.

item.title: GBP/JPY remains close to multi-year peak as UK-Japan rate gap and Iran risks undermine JPY
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross scales higher for the second straight day and climbs to a fresh weekly top, around the 217.70 region, during the first half of the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Dow Jones futures edge lower as traders weigh on US-Iran tensions
item.description: Dow Jones futures inch lower by 0.04% to trade around 52,770 during European trading hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq 100 futures advance 0.19% and 0.79%, trading near 7,600 and 30,030, respectively.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Inflation scenarios guide rate path – ABN AMRO
item.description: ABN AMRO’s Rogier Quaedvlieg reviews the latest United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) downside surprise and its implications for the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar retreats after soft inflation data, focus shifts to BoC rate decision
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, July 15:

item.title: US Dollar: Support pillar weakens after CPI – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes that weaker US CPI has sharply reduced market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike, undermining a key source of recent US Dollar strength.
